ru.title: Наша Таня (Agniya Barto)
translationLines: She dropped her ball into the river.
The ball won't sink in the river.

ru.title: Мишка (Agniya Barto)
translationLines: They dropped the teddy bear on the floor,
They tore off the teddy bear's paw.
Because he is a good one.

ru.title: Бычок (Agniya Barto)
translationLines: Now I am going to fall!

ru.title: Зайка (Agniya Barto)
translationLines: The bunny was left out in the rain.
He couldn't climb off the bench,
He got soaked to the skin.

ru.title: Лошадка (Agniya Barto)
translationLines: I will comb her coat smooth,
I will smooth her tail with a comb
And ride her to visit friends.

ru.title: Самолет (Agniya Barto)
translationLines: We will build an airplane ourselves,
We will zoom over the forests.
We will zoom over the forests,

ru.title: Спать пора (Agniya Barto)
translationLines: Time to sleep! The bull fell asleep,
Lay in the box on his side.
The sleepy bear lay in bed,
Only the elephant doesn't want to sleep.

ru.title: Гуси-гуси (Folklore)
translationLines: Do you want to eat? — Yes-yes-yes!
The grey wolf is under the hill!

ru.title: Кот на ковре (Short Rhyme)
translationLines: The cat rolled on the carpet,
Saw a mouse in the morning.
The mouse hid in the hole.

ru.title: Снегирь (Agniya Barto)
translationLines: A bullfinch sat on a branch,
And outside the window a blizzard.

ru.title: Козлёнок (Agniya Barto)
translationLines: I will take the goat to the green garden

ru.title: Флажок (Agniya Barto)
translationLines: The flag shines in the sun,
As if I lit a fire.

ru.title: Грузовик (Agniya Barto)
translationLines: To ride the cat in the car:
The cat is not used to riding —

ru.title: Мячик (Short Rhyme)
translationLines: Where did you rush off galloping?

ru.title: Ладушки (Folklore)
translationLines: What did you drink? — Sweet drink!

ru.title: Каравай (Folklore)
translationLines: We baked a loaf of bread.

ru.title: Синичка (Simple Poem)
translationLines: Everyone is glad to see her.

ru.title: Дождик (Folklore)
translationLines: Eat a little at a time!

ru.title: Солнечный зайчик (Simple Poem)
translationLines: A sunbeam skips on the wall

ru.title: Ёжик (Simple Poem)
translationLines: On his needles he carries a mushroom,

ru.title: Белочка (Simple Poem)
translationLines: And in the hollow it's warm,

ru.title: Теремок (Folklore)
translationLines: There is a little house in field,
Who lives in the low one?

ru.title: Курочка Ряба (Folklore)
lines: И была у них курочка Ряба.

ru.title: Жук (Simple Poem)
lines: Жук упал и встать не может,
translationLines: Beetle fell and can't get up,

ru.title: Щенок (Simple Poem)
lines: Он бежит ко мне со всех ног.
translationLines: He runs to me as fast as he can.

be.title: Родны кут (Якуб Колас)
lines: Мой родны кут, як ты мне мілы!..
translationLines: My native corner, how dear you are to me!..
I do not have the strength to forget you!
More than once, tired by the road,
By the life of my poor spring...

be.title: Спадчына (Янка Купала)
translationLines: From the memory of my ancestors
A heritage was left to me;
It is marked for me with grace.

be.title: Слуцкія ткачыхі (Максім Багдановіч)
lines: Ад родных ніў, ад родных хат
translationLines: From native fields, from native homes
Fate pulled them to foreign lands,
And as children they were driven to weave

be.title: Заранка (Якуб Колас)
translationLines: The morning star shines over the pine forest,
And the open expanse sings a song again,
Where the beauty of my country lies.

be.title: Каток (Народная забаўлянка)
translationLines: A little cat walks around the garden,
And the female cat — through the orchard,

be.title: Песня і колас (Янка Купала)
translationLines: And by the river in the meadow
A mower was mowing the green meadow.
